sample_source.evidence: In the present study, we have characterized and compared the plasma proteomes of two large independent cohorts of obese and overweight individuals using shotgun MS-based proteomics.

One cohort comes from a Canadian single-center clinical weight management program while the other one belongs to a multicenter pan-European weight loss study (i.e., the DiOGenes study for which MS proteomic data have been already deposited to the ProteomeXchange Consortium with the dataset identifier PXD005216).
